Package io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.poweredup

@NullMarked package io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.poweredup
Remote control of LEGO Powered Up hubs over Bluetooth Low Energy, backed by the Arduino ArduinoBLE library.
  • Class
    Description
    BuiltInSensor
    A sensor built into the Technic Hub (88012).
    HubColor
    A colour of a Powered Up hub's status LED, one of the eleven fixed colours the hub's LED protocol offers.
    HubPort
    Deprecated.
    Kept for one compatibility release.
    LinkedMotors
    Two motors of one Powered Up hub paired into a virtual port, so one call drives both in sync, as for a two-motor vehicle.
    PoweredUpAccelerometer
    The Technic Hub's accelerometer: gravity-compensated acceleration along X, Y and Z.
    PoweredUpBattery
    The Technic Hub's battery as the board's shared Battery interface: the hub's own charge percentage, and its supply voltage read from the hub's internal voltage sensor.
    PoweredUpGyroscope
    The Technic Hub's gyroscope.
    PoweredUpMotor
    The motor on one external port of a Powered Up hub, as an EncoderMotor.
    PoweredUpPort
    An external port of a Powered Up hub, printed on the hub as A to D: it takes a motor or an external sensor.
    PoweredUpTilt
    The Technic Hub's tilt sensor: three angles in degrees, yaw first, then pitch and roll.
    RemotePoweredUpHub
    A LEGO Powered Up hub (City Hub 88009, Technic Hub 88012, BOOST Move Hub 88006, DUPLO Train Hub, ...) controlled over Bluetooth Low Energy, recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno and backed by the Arduino ArduinoBLE library (arduino-cli lib install ArduinoBLE).
